Every machine of an installation boots Spin OS, built for one release of spin. The module reads the image of each machine from the image catalog on spin-terraform-aws's `catalog` branch, through the spin provider, by `spin_version` (a release, or a channel such as `edge`) and region, and boots each role's newest build whose signature it checks. An installation of `v20261125.01` can be made in a region listed here and nowhere else. To boot images of your own, name them with `image_ids` and their measurements with `image_measurements` ([the module's variables](/reference/terraform/root/#image_ids)).

| Region | Control plane | Proxy | Runner |
|---|---|---|---|
| `us-east-1` | `ami-036d78b81bae19930` | `ami-038b9f719b33ef6c1` | `ami-089c2ae3a6b4da4d7` |
| `us-west-2` | `ami-003b36af00d4d140b` | `ami-0f00dee4e3a6203b4` | `ami-0f54c73e8a48921fa` |
